mechanism_narrative: A high level of retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS exceeds its 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeding 9.0% signals severe labor market deterioration, triggering risk aversion and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 and unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 9.0% indicates a deepening economic contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through sector-wide profit compression.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 90 and UNRATE > 9.0%.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS ≤ 1.0%), the S&P 500 experiences positive forward returns over 60 trading days as lower interest rates boost equity valuations and stimulate economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL level above 220 indicates persistent inflationary pressures, prompting central bank tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 220.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 350,000 signals broad economic weakness, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate visibility.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 100 and RSAFS < 350000.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS exceeds its 50th percentile.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 400 thousand units signals weak residential construction, a leading indicator of economic slowdown, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 400.
